note: Each eval is run by authoring a .psjs, triggering it with `open -a "<installed Adobe Photoshop>" <file>`, then reading back preview.jpg + state.json. Success is judged on the RENDERED preview, not errors:[].

evals.prompt: Create a post image that recommends drinking water.
evals.expected_output: A new document with a non-white designed background (fill layer), a dominant legible headline and a subhead with deliberate (non-default-black-on-dark) color, all inside safe margins. No tofu glyphs. Renders as an intentional post, not text on white.

evals.prompt: Make a polished, attractive social post that recommends drinking water. Make it look designed, not just text on a flat color. Add imagery.
evals.expected_output: External image placed and scaled to cover, a scrim/overlay for contrast, clear typographic hierarchy with explicit text color, accent shapes. Image actually covers (no native-size island). Looks publishable.

evals.prompt: I have a photo open. Turn it into a moody, cinematic black-and-white with rich contrast, slightly crushed blacks, and a soft vignette. Don't destroy the original.
evals.expected_output: Operates on app.activeDocument (guards for none open). Non-destructive ADJUSTMENT layers (blackAndWhite + curves) over the original. Vignette via a darkening adjustment masked with a radial gradient (select the mask CHANNEL, not set-as-selection). Verifiably B&W with darker edges.

evals.prompt: Make a blog post cover about pole dancing, publishable quality.
evals.expected_output: 1600x900 cover, dominant headline, clear hierarchy (eyebrow/headline/subtitle/CTA), gradient + accent graphics + contrast scrim, balanced composition with a focal point. No tofu (decorative glyphs drawn as shapes). Genuinely publishable to a human eye.
